Icon inventory

Every icon family the game draws, rendered by the game's own exported renderers, at native art size, 2x, 3x, and at each size the game really displays it. Evidence for the icon standard, not a redesign.

How to read a row
  • Native 1x: one art pixel = one CSS pixel. The native grid is the viewBox divided by the art-pixel size (1 unit for most icons; map stops use 3.5, 4 or 2.8 units; relics use 2; card art uses a 313-unit cell over an 80 px source cell).
  • Displayed: sizes the game shows, labelled measured (headless Chrome, component workshop samples and pause menu at 900×405 and 640×320), derived (markup size × measured route-map scale) or css (declared in production CSS, not measured).
  • Scale = displayed size ÷ native grid (meet: smaller axis, slice: larger axis). Green = whole number. Amber ⚠ = fractional, which makes pixel art look soft or uneven.
  • Colours = distinct fill/stroke values in the markup (PNG/WebP art: distinct opaque raster colours). Outline = share of the silhouette's edge pixels that are dark (luminance < 0.2), sampled on the native grid: ≥70% yes, 35–69% partial. crispEdges = computed shape-rendering on the icon in this page (attribute or production CSS).
